summary: This study tests HDM1002 tablets compared to another medicine called dapagliflozin in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, which is a condition where the body does not properly manage blood sugar. Participants will take study medications while continuing treatment for their diabetes. The study plans to enroll 800 participants. Currently, the status of the trial is Recruiting.

facts.sponsor: Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
